page.notes: Handwritten note in the left margin ("aliud exemplum") is manuscript, not printed, and is omitted. The running head is heavily inked and only partly legible. Spelling kept as printed: "demnatum", "accufatur", "contrariè". Converted as required: "uindicare" to "vindicare", "uberius" to "vberius" is kept as "uberius" in the printed Latin; "Auentinum" to "Aventinum", "ciuem" to "civem"; "ma ieftatis" to "maiestatis". Printed Latin "Inftitutionib." read as "Institutionib.". The "con-" at the end is a line-end hyphen, not a catchword, so it stays in the text.
